title: Streaks App Habit Load by Day
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:streak weekday=* habits_due=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(habits_due) as metric by _time weekday
| sort 0 _time weekday
description: Trends monthly habits due by weekday for Streaks workload.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether Streaks workload are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `weekday` on `lifeos:streak` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly habits due.
visualization: Line chart of monthly habits due by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It records how habits due changes month by month for each weekday so you can see whether Streaks workload are heading the right way.
